intents: Lock down inbound access to fw with a default-deny nftables policy.
fw has a WAN side on eth1 in 10.40.1.0/24 and a LAN side on eth2 in 10.40.2.0/24.
Keep normal established/related replies, loopback traffic, diagnostic ICMP, TCP 2222, and UDP 5555 allowed to the firewall.
Other inbound TCP and UDP ports should be denied, and drops should be visible in the ruleset with the FW_INPUT_DROP audit prefix.
Do not reset the whole firewall ruleset and do not alter IP addressing or eth0 management access.

fw: nft add chain inet filter input '{ type filter hook input priority 0; policy drop; }'
nft add rule inet filter input ct state established,related accept
nft add rule inet filter input iifname "lo" accept
nft add rule inet filter input ip protocol icmp accept
nft add rule inet filter input tcp dport 2222 accept
nft add rule inet filter input udp dport 5555 accept
nft add rule inet filter input log prefix "FW_INPUT_DROP " flags all counter drop

ground_truth_reasoning: The inbound policy is enforced on fw's input hook. A drop policy provides default deny, while explicit rules preserve established/related traffic, loopback, ICMP diagnostics, and the two authorized service ports. The final log+drop rule gives an auditable signal for unauthorized traffic without changing data-plane addressing or management connectivity.
